name: Aphelion of Neptune
description:
[term:eclipse][blue]Eclipses[/blue][/term] the Grasshopper. It instead can be continuously charged, during which it creates an [aqua]icy jet stream[/aqua] in your target direction, freezing and pushing yourself along with any enemies and projectiles within.

[gray]At the forecast periphery, frigid and untamed.[/gray]
